title: 1권 3유닛 장면 · 3
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: A muddy puddle at the edge of the garden. A chubby purple-grey hippo lies happily in the mud with a glowing golden seed resting on top of its head. Bun stands on a stepping stone pointing at the hippo; Hedgie holds his nose; Pip hovers over the hippo, glowing. Behind them a new letter tree with goat-, gift- and guitar-shaped fruits has just sprouted. Hidden in the picture: a glass bottle of blue ink with a feather quill on a garden bench. In the back corner, Grumble has crept closer behind a bush: one acorn cap has fallen off his ear, and his lantern now shows a small steady flame. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
